conservation.condition_narrative: "July 1962 thin coat of polyvinyl acetate (AYAF) and butyl methacrylate (Lucite #46) # 1869" (Fine Arts Conservation Laboratories  typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

conservation.condition_narrative:
The painting was unframed for Collection Photography, both front and back. It appears to be in good condition and unchanged from previous records. It was re-framed after photography was complete. 
The D-rings could be updated in the future.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Brooklyn Museum of Art in 2025.

cr_data.provenance: Artist (The), until 1986; Estate of Georgia O’Keeffe (The), Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1986-1987, Brooklyn Museum (The), 1987 (Source: Brooklyn Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks note of inscription 1 and indicate date "36." Dated 1935 on basis of backing inscription 2, inclusion in 1936 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
